method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill (and references/regulative.md), from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18 and the rulings on negatives of 2026-11-04 and 2026-11-05 (JUST FALSE where the text says no, NOTHING with a NOTHING-kind tag where it does not answer); dates in a small module, the rules in one module and the worker's questions in a seat module importing it; two regulative rules (the worker's time limits, and the WHS prosecutor's duty to answer a request for a prosecution) run by EVALTRACE inside exported questions that take only plain facts; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Work Health and Safety Act 2011 (Qld), Act No. 18 of 2011, the version in force from 2026-08-03 (current on 2026-11-06), as deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/act-2011-018.txt (text sha256 43496be6492cdcc9b46b409a12bd7c2c937d840eef2bdb51963fe74c1db40add), retrieved from legislation.qld.gov.au on 2026-11-06. The Work Health and Safety Regulation 2011 is not deposited: its prescribed matters are asked as facts.

seat: the worker (or prospective worker) to whom the Act is applied when hurt or put at risk at work, stopping unsafe work, treated badly for raising safety, seeking a prosecution of the person responsible, or affected by an inspector's or the regulator's decision (qwhs-seat.l4); the s 231 questions serve equally the family of a worker who died

checks.l4: stable l4 of VS Code extension legalese.l4-vscode 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset
checks.command: l4 run qwhs-dates.l4 ; l4 run qwhs-rules.l4 ; l4 run qwhs-seat.l4 ; l4 run qwhs-cases.l4
checks.result: 186 assertions written, 186 satisfied, 0 errors, 0 warnings in every file (2026-11-07)
checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics were read; satisfied assertions were counted by distinct source range. Expected values worked by hand from the text.

scope: Focus: the provisions a claimant meets. In: ss 5(1), (4), (6)-(8), 7; ss 31-34, 34B(1), 34C, 34D (maximum penalties); Part 3 (ss 35-39); ss 83-88 (right to cease unsafe work); Part 6 whole (ss 104-115, discriminatory, coercive and misleading conduct, the civil claim to the Industrial Relations Commission, court orders on conviction); s 184; ss 223, 224, 226, 228, 229, 229B and schedule 2A (review); ss 231, 232 (request for a prosecution, limitation); ss 267, 272, 273. Out: Part 2 Divisions 1-4 (duties, enforced by prosecution, no civil action: s 267), Parts 4, 5 (other divisions), 5A, 7, 8-11, the rest of Parts 12-14, Parts 15-16, schedules 1-3. Reasons in NOTES.md.
